content: targetSdk 34 (Android 14) enforces: foreground services must declare an android:foregroundServiceType per <service> in the manifest matching runtime start calls; SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is no longer pre-granted (denied by default) and must be explicitly requested if exact alarms are used. Neither applies directly to this project (no foreground service, no exact alarms planned), but confirms targetSdk 34 adds manifest-level strictness that a hand-built manifest must get exactly right or the app may crash/misbehave at runtime with no compiler warning.
